name: Tiny Racers
tagline: Tiny cars racing across tables, desks and floors around the house. Race the bots, your own ghost, or each other on the same Wi-Fi.
requires: For Android phones and tablets. Plays in landscape.
note: Had Tiny Racers 0.3.0 or older? **Uninstall it once first.** The game moved to a new signing key in 0.4.0, so Android won't install the new version over the old one. From now on, updates install over each other.
